item.title: Sam Grisman Project Releases Long-Awaited Debut Rooted in Bluegrass and the Grateful Dead
item.description: Sam Grisman releases the Sam Grisman Project debut, blending bluegrass standards and Grateful Dead classics with warm, supportive upright bass.

item.title: Watch Jack Bruce on Fretless Warwick in a Newly Resurfaced 1991 Take on “Smiles and Grins”
item.description: Jack Bruce’s fretless Warwick tone stands out at Jazzgipfel supported by his Trace Elliot and Hartke rig offering a clear view of his phrasing and commanding presence.

item.title: Bass of the Week: Oroboro Guitars’ Cobra 4 Blends Celluloid Craftsmanship With a Modern V Design
item.description: Oroboro Guitars’ Cobra 4 is a headless, multi-scale V-style bass with celluloid accents, Lace Aluma pickups, and a striking custom aesthetic.

item.title: Biffy Clyro Bassist James Johnston Steps Away From Upcoming Tour to Focus on Mental Health
item.description: Biffy Clyro bassist James Johnston has announced he will miss the band’s upcoming European tour as he seeks professional help for mental health issues.

item.title: Pino Palladino Brings Fretless Mastery to “That Was a Dream” with Blake Mills
item.description: Pino brings an easy fretless feel to this quiet duo performance with Blake Mills offering a clear look at his touch tone and space in a live setting. (158 characters)

item.title: Höfner Files for Bankruptcy in Germany, Putting Iconic Violin Bass Maker in Limbo
item.description: Höfner, the iconic maker of the Violin Bass popularized by Paul McCartney, has filed for insolvency in Germany as court-appointed administrators seek solutions.

item.title: The SansAmp Classic Returns: Tech 21 Revives Its Foundational Pedal in 2026
item.description: Tech 21 will reintroduce the SansAmp Classic for a limited run in 2026, reviving the original all-analog pedal that helped define direct bass tone.

item.title: Mono Debuts PFX Instrument Cables With Modular Connector Options
item.description: Mono has introduced its PFX Instrument Cable series, built in Japan with modular connector options and designs tailored for studio and live performance.

item.title: “Take Five” Reimagined: Ellen Alaverdyan Handles the Groove and the Melody with Gregg Bissonette
item.description: Ellen Alaverdyan handles melody and groove in a smooth Take Five performance with Gregg Bissonette adding lift and color for a tight and charming take on the classic tune.

item.title: Learn Descending Triads on Bass With a Groove-Based Chord Tone Exercise
item.description: Learn how to practice descending triads on bass using chord tones, fretboard shapes, and a groove-based exercise in the key of D.
